name: Astemo Americas, Inc. Berea Plant No. 2
old_description: Astemo Americas Joins NVIDIA DRIVE Hyperion Ecosystem as Tier-1 Partner
about:
Astemo Americas, Inc. operates its Berea Plant No. 2 in Berea, Kentucky. The facility traces its roots to 1986, and the current corporate entity was formed in January 2021 when Hitachi Automotive Systems, Keihin, Showa, and Nissin Kogyo merged to create the global mega-supplier Astemo. The plant is a manufacturing site within Astemo's North American footprint.

The company develops and manufactures automotive components across four core domains: electric powertrains, advanced chassis systems, autonomous driving and advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS), and motorcycle systems. It also supplies aftermarket products and provides sales and engineering support from offices such as the recently opened East Liberty location. A major expansion of manufacturing operations in Kentucky was announced in 2026.

Astemo serves automotive OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers, with concrete engagements including a Tier-1 partnership in the NVIDIA DRIVE Hyperion ecosystem for autonomous driving and an INDYCAR program with Team Penske and Chevrolet. Its customer base extends to motorsports teams and the aftermarket channel.

The company states its mission is to provide a safe, sustainable, and comfortable mobility life through technologies that contribute to an advanced and sustainable society, aiming to reduce traffic accidents, congestion, and environmental impact through cleaner exhaust and improved fuel efficiency.
